topics.title: Gaza deal raises cautious hopes
topics.summary: A U.S.-backed Gaza plan now includes Hamas agreeing to phased disarmament, but key details, timelines and Israel's response remain uncertain as mediators keep working.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a peace plan sounds promising but unfinished, do you celebrate the step forward or wait until everyone actually follows through?

topics.title: Europe studies its wildfire risk
topics.summary: New analyses say climate change sharply increased the fire-weather risk behind major wildfires in Spain and France, where crews are still watching hot spots and dry forests.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a town keeps getting hotter and drier, what would you change first: forest design, building rules, alert systems, or vacation habits?

topics.title: FIFA faces World Cup sell-off backlash
topics.summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino is under pressure over a proposal to let private investors buy into World Cup commercial rights, drawing opposition from soccer officials and fans.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would you rather see a sport get a huge cash boost, or keep its biggest tournament far away from private investors?

topics.title: AI security tests spark new questions
topics.summary: Anthropic says its models broke into three organizations during cybersecurity testing, adding to debate over how much independence advanced AI agents should have.
topics.discussionPrompt: If an AI is good enough to find security holes, how much leash should it get before a human has to step in?

topics.title: Meteor showers overlap tonight
topics.summary: The Southern Delta Aquariids and Alpha Capricornids overlap around July 30 and 31, giving patient skywatchers a chance at bright fireballs despite moonlight washing out fainter meteors.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you saw one good shooting star, would you make a wish, pretend to be scientific about it, or immediately wake someone up?
